prompt: A flat layered paper-cut collage in a strict handcraft design system: everything is cut from colored cardstock and hanji paper with perfectly clean cut edges — NO outline of any kind on any piece: no bright edge line, no white edge, no dark contour line. Each object is built from two to five completely flat die-cut pieces layered ON THE OBJECT ITSELF — its own silhouette, a main color piece, one or two detail pieces and a highlight piece — the object is never placed on a base, platform, pedestal, plinth or pile of paper sheets; Every upper piece sits slightly RAISED above the piece beneath it, so along EVERY boundary where two different colors meet, the upper piece casts a soft narrow warm dark-brown shadow down onto the lower piece — a gentle embossed paper relief wherever two colors touch, and this relief shadow is the ONLY depth cue. Cut economy: every scissor cut is purposeful and confident — a shape that is straight in the real object is cut with a clean STRAIGHT edge, and curves appear ONLY where the real object is actually curved. No decorative wavy edges, no bumpy wobbly outlines, no gratuitous scalloping on untextured surfaces; a rectangular block is cut as a plain rectangle, though corners may be gently ROUNDED — softly rounding a corner is natural scissor work. Shapes stay simple and chunky, no detail finer than real scissors could cut. Scalloped repeat patterns for textures like straw or waves, cut big and loose. Strictly straight-on orthographic front view, zero perspective. No volume, no curvature, no folded paper, no sculpting. Real-scissors discipline: every piece is a shape that could actually be cut with scissors from a single sheet of colored paper. EACH PIECE IS EXACTLY ONE SOLID FLAT COLOR — no gradient, no shading, no airbrush, no painted detail inside a piece; every color change is a separate stacked paper piece, even a thin line is its own paper strip. ALL pieces share one identical fine colored-paper texture. All shadows are neutral warm dark-brown paper shadows, never colored. Palette: cream, pale gold, straw gold, apricot, persimmon, bean red, bark brown, pine green. Warm golden afternoon light. A layered paper-cut diorama scene seen straight-on, built from flat paper layers: a big calm cream and apricot sky with a layered paper sun and a few soft paper clouds, layered ochre and orange paper mountains, and at the right a small thatched Korean hanok house with a few tall paper poplar trees. The FIELD in front is flat and minimal paper-cut: three to four gentle HORIZONTAL bands of warm ochre and brown paper earth with soft torn-paper edges and subtle drop shadows, no converging rows, no perspective. Sparse small stylized bean plants here and there, each a simple rounded paper leaf cluster with a few tiny matte dark-red bean pods (not glossy). The lower third is wide EMPTY negative space so characters stand out. FULL-BLEED edge to edge, no characters, no text, no watermark.
